# BeginTech

> BeginTech is a web development agency and software house based in Karachi, Pakistan. We design and build websites, online stores, mobile apps, custom software and AI systems, and provide UI/UX design, branding and digital marketing — for clients across Pakistan and worldwide.

BeginTech is a small, senior studio (operating since 2016) that designs, builds and grows digital products. The portfolio below is real, shipped client work — not fabricated case studies.

## Company

- [Homepage](https://begintech.co/): overview, services and featured work.
- [About](https://begintech.co/about): who BeginTech is, principles and history.
- [Contact](https://begintech.co/contact): get in touch, based in Karachi, Pakistan.
- [Blog](https://begintech.co/blog): articles on web development, mobile apps, AI and running digital projects.
